more_info.side_effects:
EFSA found no concern for the assessed limited food uses.
Higher-dose animal studies identified nervous-system effects of aluminium.
more_info.overview: Aluminium potassium sulphate is a hydrated double sulphate salt of aluminium and potassium, also known as potassium alum. Its acidity-regulating role is to adjust or maintain the pH of the food. The specified material is supplied as white powder or crystalline material. The specification identifies water solubility as one of its properties.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain other confectionery including breath freshening microsweets.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
